Sagitaur
Large wheeled Kin vehicle
AC 17 | HP 90 | DT 10 | Speed 60 ft | Handling +1
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 6 | Cargo 300 kg | Exceptional
Weapons: forward bolt cannon and turret HYLas rotary cannon (same G; choose one per action). Enclosed; Sealed; 
no firing ports. Ignores rubble and shallow mud. Kin-sized spaces need refitting for other species; no Ogryn 
accommodation.
